Timeline of Jainism
Jainism
is an ancient
Indian religion
belonging to the
śramaṇa
tradition. It prescribes
ahimsa
(non-violence) towards all living beings to the greatest possible extent. The three main teachings of Jainism are
ahimsa
,
anekantavada
(non-absolutism), and
aparigraha
(non-possessiveness). Followers of Jainism take five main vows:
ahimsa
,
satya
(not lying),
asteya
(non stealing),
brahmacharya
(chastity), and
aparigraha
. Monks follow them completely whereas
śrāvakas
(householders) observe them partially. Self-discipline and
asceticism
are thus major focuses of Jainism.
